focus.title: 美国拟将中国跨境电商平台列入‘恶名市场’名单，涉知识产权与假冒商品
focus.summary: 据多方消息，美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）正考虑在2026年度的《特别301报告》中，将部分中国跨境电商平台列入‘恶名市场’名单，理由是平台上存在大量知识产权侵权和假冒商品。此举可能引发更严格的审查和贸易限制。中国出海企业应加强知识产权布局，完善平台合规机制，并准备应对潜在的美国市场准入变化。
focus.source: 来源：USTR年度报告草案及行业消息 · 2026.08.19
focus.title_en: USTR May Add Chinese Cross-Border E-Commerce Platforms to 'Notorious Markets' List over IP Concerns
focus.summary_en: According to multiple sources, the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) is considering adding certain Chinese cross-border e-commerce platforms to its 'Notorious Markets' list in the 2026 Special 301 Report, citing widespread IP infringement and counterfeit goods. This could lead to stricter scrutiny and trade restrictions. Chinese companies going global should strengthen IP protection, enhance platform compliance, and prepare for potential changes in U.S. market access.
focus.source_en: Source: USTR Annual Report Draft & Industry Reports · 2026.08.19

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境股权回购协议中‘重大不利变化’条款的适用标准
case.summary: 新加坡国际仲裁中心近期审结一起涉中资企业跨境股权回购纠纷。仲裁庭认为，被申请人援引的‘重大不利变化’（MAC）条款不适用于因行业正常波动导致的业绩下滑，必须存在对目标公司价值的根本性、持续性损害。该裁决明确了MAC条款的严格适用标准，为中国企业起草跨境投资协议提供了参考：应细化MAC定义，避免模糊表述，并明确举证责任。
case.source: 来源：SIAC案例摘要（2026年第3季度）
case.title_en: SIAC Award Clarifies 'Material Adverse Change' Clause in Cross-Border Share Repurchase Agreement
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Arbitration Centre recently concluded a dispute involving a Chinese enterprise's cross-border share repurchase. The tribunal held that the 'Material Adverse Change' (MAC) clause invoked by the respondent did not apply to performance decline caused by normal industry fluctuations; there must be fundamental and lasting damage to the target company's value. The award clarifies the strict standard for MAC clauses, providing guidance for Chinese companies in drafting cross-border investment agreements: refine MAC definitions, avoid vague wording, and clarify burden of proof.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规出台：明确‘白名单’机制与安全评估流程
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室近期发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规范（试行）》，首次在大湾区内地九市与香港、澳门之间建立数据跨境‘白名单’机制，对列入白名单的常见业务数据（如物流、支付、跨境电商）实行简化安全评估。企业需按照规范进行数据分类分级，并在规定时限内完成备案。此举将大幅提升大湾区跨境贸易效率，但企业需注意合规责任。
policy.source: 来源：广东省网信办发布 · 2026.08.15
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area: 'Whitelist' Mechanism and Security Assessment Process
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province recently issued the 'Regulations on Security Management for Cross-Border Data Flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', establishing a 'whitelist' mechanism for cross-border data between nine mainland cities and Hong Kong/Macau, simplifying security assessments for common business data (e.g., logistics, payment, cross-border e-commerce). Enterprises must classify data and complete filing within specified deadlines. This will significantly enhance cross-border trade efficiency in the GBA, but enterprises must be aware of compliance obligations.

analysis.title: 美国对华投资限制新规生效在即，企业应重构合规体系并关注‘例外’条款
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部关于对华投资限制的最终规则将于2026年9月1日生效，涉及半导体、AI、量子计算等领域。建议中国出海企业：一是梳理现有及未来投资架构，评估是否落入受限范围；二是关注‘例外’条款（如被动投资、公司内部交易等），合理规划交易路径；三是建立动态合规监测机制，与美方律师协同应对不确定性。英文以Attorney Qin's view开头。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部最终规则及律师实务分析 · 2026.08.19
analysis.title_en: U.S. Outbound Investment Restrictions Take Effect Soon: Compliance Overhaul and 'Exception' Clauses
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. Treasury's final rules on outbound investment restrictions will take effect on September 1, 2026, covering semiconductors, AI, quantum computing, etc. Chinese companies going global should: first, review existing and future investment structures to assess whether they fall within the restricted scope; second, pay attention to 'exception' clauses (e.g., passive investments, intra-company transactions) and plan transaction paths reasonably; third, establish a dynamic compliance monitoring mechanism and collaborate with U.S. counsel to address uncertainties.
analysis.source_en: Source: U.S. Treasury Final Rules & Attorney Analysis · 2026.08.19
